title: Predict goals and uncertainty
outcome: Build a Poisson goal model and simulate scorelines and season outcomes.

blocks.body: Question: What does a forecast actually promise?
Mathematics: Learn random variables, conditional probability, independence, expectation, variance, likelihood, and numerical integration.

Dataset: StatsBomb Open Data: competitions.json → matches/{competition_id}/{season_id}.json. Use scores, dates, and information available before kickoff. Build recent-form features only from earlier matches.
Reading: Mathematics for Machine Learning chapter 6. Use simulation before formal probability notation.

blocks.title: Mathematics for Machine Learning
blocks.note: Use selected sections as a reference after the visual experiment. The authors provide a free PDF.

blocks.title: An Introduction to Statistical Learning · Python
blocks.note: Use selected chapters and Python labs. The book PDF is free on the authors’ site.

blocks.body: Challenge: Explain why a 70% forecast can lose. Calculate conditional probability on a small match table.

tasks.prompt: Estimate goal rates using training data and plot a Poisson distribution, a model for event counts.
